requirements: Qualify 4-, 8- and 16-port SKUs with a shared selectable clock, negotiation/recovery firmware and receiver-credit-aware arbiter. Forward by streaming at one common rate; no per-port rate conversion. Separate per-port connector/transceiver/protection costs from shared logic/PSU. Qualify cables, fault isolation and diagnostics at 100/250/500/1000 kbit/s. Port count does not multiply the maximum 1 Mbit/s shared raw capacity.
Manufacturer/MPN or released make drawing, approved alternatives and historical supply qualification
PCB dimensions, layer stack, finish, connectors, fitted passives and reference designators
Power per rail, startup/thermal limits and region-specific power configuration
Firmware image capacity/revision, programming and verification
Assembly routing, test fixtures, cycle times, yield/rework/scrap and packout
